limitations: Only exact ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off WEEE shredding is reviewed, per source negative one kg of waste and native positive one kg shredding service. The same documented mechanical chain has two shredding, two magnetic-separation and two eddy-current-separation stages. Source and native use the same 8e-10 facility-unit coefficient. All 15 source direct air emissions match native2026 by publisher UUID, full receiving compartment, unit and amount. Factor -1 converts negative source waste demand to positive native treatment demand once, retaining signed caller quantities, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separate caller emissions.

Use the complete native CH shredding process once. Source uses 0.066 kWh of global medium-voltage electricity per kg; native uses 0.02 kWh of Swiss supply and lists 0.014535 tkm Swiss rail and 0.028215 tkm Swiss 16-32t lorry freight. Native also reports 0.2376 MJ waste heat absent from the source inventory. These operating, geography, electricity, transport, heat-reporting, vintage, infrastructure/upstream and internal-uncertainty differences are explicit screening limitations with unquantified score effects. The complete native model replaces the original source internal model; no numerical LCI/LCIA/stochastic equivalence is claimed.

The facility/mass-processing function is the basis; no 3.3 electricity ratio, heat-balance, payload, lifetime, capacity or energy-efficiency correction is applied to the kg of treatment or direct emission vector. Add no source electricity, duplicate facility/freight, avoided virgin-metal credit, extra recovered-metal output, invented residue treatment or extra heat credit. Caller-listed recovery inputs/credits and emissions remain independent and unchanged. Other source versions, patches, system models or reverse routes gain no approval.

limitations: Only exact ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off RER market for 16-32t Euro V lorry freight is reviewed. It has one positive unit share of the complete RER transport service, with no additional freight, market loss or direct biosphere exchange. Native is also a complete 16-32t gross-weight transport life cycle per positive tkm, including operation, vehicle, maintenance, end of life and road infrastructure. Factor +1 preserves signed caller tkm, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separate caller emissions.

The source describes Euro V and average European journeys/load factors, with HBEFA3.1-based exhaust factors. Native2026 is a Swiss2020 fleet-average Mobitool/HBEFA5.1 model; emissions standards, fuel/traction, loads, journeys, fleet weighting, infrastructure quantities, geography, vintage and internal uncertainty differ. This is an explicit same-class whole-service screening proxy, not exact Euro V performance. Source internal regional/fleet distributions are replaced by the complete native model, with unquantified score effects and no LCI/LCIA/stochastic-equivalence claim.

Keep the original tkm once. No payload, gross-weight, fuel, EURO-class or distance multiplier, extra truck/road burden, source operating inventory, emissions correction, avoided transport credit, inferred inverse, other source version/patch or cross-system-model route is introduced.
